Based on all three inputs, it seems the recommendation needs to be revised to a $3,000,000 dividend payable on October 15, 2026, with a $450,000 withholding reserve and a filing deadline of 10 business days after payment. Before I sign off, can each of you confirm: Jonas, will you attach the covenant schedule to the approval packet? Elena, will you circulate the shareholder residency schedule to finance and confirm the withholding figures at $3,000,000? Ravi, will you update the draft recommendation to reflect the October 15 payment date?
